plugins.name: Miftah — مفتاح (Alpha)
plugins.description: Authenticated native /v1/models discovery without custom CPA images or Caddy; returns global catalog while execution remains per-key restricted. Searchable models, ordered fallback, automatic CPA theme, optional routes and budgets. Preserves native CPA keys. STAGING ONLY: Linux amd64, glibc >= 2.34; NOT Alpine/musl or ARM64. Tested with CPA v7.2.146. Restart CPA after update. Read INSTALL.md.
plugins.author: Abdulaziz
